Three players each hold one hidden card; deck ranks1–8 with multiplicities5/2/2/2/2/1/1/1 (sixteen cards). One undealt card hidden to prevent complete certainty. Eliminated cards public. When stock empty, highest retained rank among survivors earns token; last survivor earns immediately. First three tokens wins.
Three favor tokens wins; first rival to three loses; simultaneous threshold ties broken next round. Tied highest survivors each earn a token; if the match lead at three is tied, continue until a unique leader.

Letters We Cannot See

A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Spend a hint to make a safe play, rescue a unique late-rank card from discard, or discard a known duplicate to fund later communication. Must reason from own accumulated positive and negative clues.

Take a seat
How to play
Two players human and transparent-policy bot, each four cards facing partner. Three suits ranks 1–5 with multiplicities 3/2/2/2/1. Build shared ascending suit stacks. On turn play own indexed card blind, discard to regain one of five hints, or spend hint naming suit/rank in partner hand: all matching cards indicated, all nonmatching excluded. Three wrong plays end game; completing rank 5 restores a hint. Deck empty grants one final turn each.
Deliver at least twelve of fifteen ranks by the end of the final replies to win; all fifteen earns perfect correspondence. Reaching twelve early does not end the game. Three mistakes always lose; final delivery below twelve loses. Restart repeats the deal; Another deal creates a new shuffled deal.

Letters We Cannot See

Cooperate through scarce truthful hints while each player cannot see their own cards.

A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Spend a hint to make a safe play, rescue a unique late-rank card from discard, or discard a known duplicate to fund later communication. Must reason from own accumulated positive and negative clues.

Take a seat
How to play
Two players human and transparent-policy bot, each four cards facing partner. Three suits ranks 1–5 with multiplicities 3/2/2/2/1. Build shared ascending suit stacks. On turn play own indexed card blind, discard to regain one of five hints, or spend hint naming suit/rank in partner hand: all matching cards indicated, all nonmatching excluded. Three wrong plays end game; completing rank 5 restores a hint. Deck empty grants one final turn each.
Deliver at least twelve of fifteen ranks by the end of the final replies to win; all fifteen earns perfect correspondence. Reaching twelve early does not end the game. Three mistakes always lose; final delivery below twelve loses. Restart repeats the deal; Another deal creates a new shuffled deal.
